Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Flamingo)

Dear Ms. Natarajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 1 May 2022 about your dispute with Qureshi Motors Ltd. As we understand it, the claim must be filed as a commercial suit. The matter is listed before the Panaji Commercial Court.

Our advice is to complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit. Please collect the mediation request and the statement of accounts and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
